inputs.label: Elevation
inputs.coverage: Radial height above a 40.6 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. Includes the moon’s broad irregular shape; it is not local height above a geoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals model slopes. Small craters are not reliably resolved.
